summary: M3.S4 (ImmobilCloud B2C Property Detail + Contact Form) fully tested. 10/10 backend pytest assertions passed (GET detail with public fields, view_count++, 404, POST contact happy path with client+lead+lead_count, duplicate-email reuses client, gdpr=false→400, msg<10→422, invalid email→422, property_not_found→404, private property→404). Frontend E2E via Playwright: all data-testids present (detail-page, title, price, key-info incl. info-surface/rooms/bedrooms/bathrooms/floor/year/energy/ref, agency-card, contact-form, schema-jsonld), Leaflet mini-map renders (detail-map + .leaflet-container), default contact message pre-populated with 'sono interessato all\'immobile', Schema.org JSON-LD has @type=RealEstateListing + addressLocality + geo, happy-path submit → contact-done visible, /it/cloud/property/non-exists → property-detail-notfound with 'Immobile non trovato'. Test data cleaned up.
action_items: (MINOR / UX) Spec asked: 'submit con gdpr non checked deve mostrare data-testid=contact-error'. Currently the submit button is `disabled={busy || !form.gdpr_consent}`, so the click never fires and no contact-error message is shown to the user. The goal (no API call) IS met, but the user gets no inline feedback explaining why the button is disabled. Consider either (a) keeping the button enabled and letting the existing onSubmit guard render contact-error, or (b) showing a small inline hint under the GDPR checkbox. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: public_portal.py contact endpoint correctly uses `agency_id + email.lower()` to dedupe clients and is idempotent.
view_count and lead_count updates are best-effort wrapped in try/except — good defensive coding.
PUBLIC_FIELDS projection correctly hides owner/seller_client_id/commission_pct/listing_agent_id/lead_count/view_count from GET /property/{pid}.
PropertyDetailPage.jsx (~399 lines) is readable but slightly large; could be split into Gallery/AgencyCard/ContactForm files for maintainability (not blocking).

Contact form does NOT include any rate-limiting / captcha — public endpoint is exposed and could be spammed. Consider adding a per-IP throttle or honeypot field in a future iteration (security hardening).
Schema.org JSON-LD emits `description: null` when description is missing — minor SEO concern, consider omitting null fields.
test_credentials: Not required for these public endpoints. Super admin (mcnicastro@gmail.com) available if needed.
seed_data_creation: Used existing property 3b81db11-2988-47a7-ae26-f4396913c3a7 (Appartamento Centro Storico Roma). Test clients/leads were created during tests using email pattern m3s4test+*@example.com and cleaned up post-test (module fixture teardown + extra UI cleanup script run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: M3.S4 (B2C property detail + contact form) fully validated. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_immobilcloud_m3s4_contact.py (10 tests, all green). Test data cleanup is automatic via pytest fixture (delete_many on source=ImmobilCloud + email regex m3s4test). Public endpoints: GET/POST /api/cloud/property/{pid}[/contact]. Frontend route /it/cloud/property/:pid. Only minor UX nit: submit button is disabled when GDPR unchecked, so contact-error message defined in onSubmit guard is never visually shown — main agent may choose to enable button and rely on onSubmit guard instead for better UX feedback.
